name: Rogue Talent
body:
Rogue Talent
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 53
A slayer can select one of the following rogue talents in place of a slayer talent: bleeding attack*, camouflageAPG, combat trick, demand attentionCAC, fast stealth, finesse rogue, firearm trainingUC, gritUC, hard to foolAPG, lasting poisonAPG, powerful sneakAPG, rogue crawl, slow reactions*, snap shotAPG, sniper’s eyeAPG, surprise attack, swift poisonAPG, terrain masteryUC, trap spotter, unwitting allyUC, weapon training, or any rogue talents from Blood of Shadows. Any talent effects based on rogue level use the slayer’s class level. If the rogue talent has a prerequisite, the slayer must meet the prerequisite before taking that rogue talent. This talent can be selected multiple times; each time, it grants the slayer a new rogue talent.
